_comment: The narration. Edit the words, then `npm run build`: the voice is re-generated and every on-screen action re-times to it. Line ids are referenced by the scenes in src/scenes/.

lines.text: You just built a game.
It looks great. It runs.
So, how do you get it onto MiniPay?
MiniPay is a phone wallet for dollar coins.
There's no sign-up, and no connect button. The wallet is just there.
So your game has to be built for that, and GoodBuild builds it that way.
Here's the whole thing, in three steps.
Step one. Deploy your contract.
Hit Deploy, and you see exactly what's going out: the contract, the network, and the estimated fee.
Try it on Celo Sepolia first, then go to mainnet.
Press Sign and deploy. You sign in your own wallet. We never hold your keys.
Sign. Broadcast. Verified. Your contract is live on Celo.
Step two. Publish.
Pick your address, tick the box, and press Publish.
A few seconds later, your game has its own public link.
Deploy first, or it goes live as a demo.
Step three. Go to MiniPay.
Open Settings, then Developer Settings. Turn on Developer Mode. Using Sepolia? Turn on Use Testnet too.
Tap Load Test Page, paste your link, and hit Go.
And there it is, inside the wallet, already connected. No wallet list. No login.
Happy with it? Submit it to MiniPay's app list.
GoodBuild already wrote the About, How to use, Terms, Privacy and Support pages, and the footer the listing asks for.
Give the Terms and Privacy a read first.
Deploy. Publish. MiniPay.
Build your game at goodbuildit dot x y z.
